senses.gloss: --a राक्षस clan, like the Bhadrakas. वा. ६९. १८९.

(I)--the son of हर्यश्व and father of बर्हणाश्व
1: भा. IX. 6. २४-25; M. १२. ३३; Vi. IV. 2. ४५.
(सम्हताश्व-वा। प्।: अमिताश्व-वि। प्।); killed in the राम-Ra1van2a war;
2: भा. IX. १०. १८; Br. III. ६३. ६४.
deep in क्षत्रिय धर्म।
3: वा. ८८. ६२-63.
(II)--a ब्रह्मराक्षस and son of स्फूर्ज residing in Sutalam. Br. II. २०. २१; III. 7. ९५; वा. ५०. २१; ६९. १३०.

(IV)--a गणेश who appeared in a dream to a Brahmana in King दिवोदास's time and asked his wor- ship to be conducted at the city gate; conferred benefits on all except the queen who wanted a son. सुयशा, the queen of दिवोदास propitiated Nikumbha with rich offerings; [page२-236+ २७] the enraged king destroyed the temple and the deity cursed the city to be ruined, informed शिव of this; from that time the temple became that of the Lord Avimukta. Br. III. ६७. २८ to the end; वा. ९२. २५-59.

(I)--(निष्कृति-भा प्।) born of Dambha and माया;
1: भा. IV. 8. 3.
the first wife of Kali.
2: वा. ८४. 9.
(II)--a daughter of हिम्सा and Adharma; mother of Bhaya and Naraka. Br. II. 9. ६३; वा. १०. ३९.
--dwellings built at the end of कृतयुग in Marudhanva, Nimna, Parvata, Nadi and Dhanva; the latter fortresses to protect from the sun and rain. वा. 8. ९६-97.
--a पुष्करणि; he who takes bath here and performs श्राद्ध in क्रौञ्जपद and lives here for three days, leads all पितृस् to heaven though subjected to five sins. वा. १०८. ८०, ८३-4. [page२-237+ २४]
--deposit; loss of, must be made good; failure to return deposit and false claim to it to be punished like theft with a fine of twice the amount involved. M. २२७. 1-2.
